title: Placement Term End and Long-Term Hardship Hold Income Records Requests
content:
**Schedule note — Hardship and Protective Holds.** When updated household income records are asked for before a status review of a running Long-Term Hardship Hold, the income term cut depends on the calendar days from today to the held account's placement term end date, as shown in its Placed Consumer Accounts record. The cut is subtracted once from the days allowed for the income records.

| Calendar days from today to the placement term end date | Income term cut |
|---|---|
| No more than the near-term window of 30 days | 4 calendar days (near-term days) |
| More than 30 but no more than the mid-term window of 60 days | 2 calendar days (mid-term days) |
| More than 60 days | Nothing |

**Both sides.** 30 days to the term end: cut 4. 31 days: cut 2. 60 days: cut 2. 61 days: nothing. A term end date already passed is no more than 30 days away, so the cut is 4.

**Example (hypothetical).** Today is 1 June and the held account's placement term ends on 20 July, 49 days away: more than 30 and no more than 60, so 2 calendar days are cut.
